Leonora Neuffer Bilger received the Francis P. Garvan–John M. Olin Medal in 1953. I haven't re-checked the cited sources in this turn, so this rests on my earlier research and recall. The team note calling her a British-born physicist at a European institute doesn't match my understanding of her as an American chemist, so I'd leave that description out until it's verified.
